mapper.insert: INSERT INTO futuresim_plan_snapshot ( app_user_id, goal_amount, goal_preset_key, selected_levers_json, baseline_months_to_goal, projected_months_to_goal, final_net_worth ) VALUES ( #{appUserId}, #{goalAmount}, #{goalPresetKey}, #{selectedLeversJson}, #{baselineMonthsToGoal}, #{projectedMonthsToGoal}, #{finalNetWorth} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE goal_amount = VALUES(goal_amount), goal_preset_key = VALUES(goal_preset_key), selected_levers_json = VALUES(selected_levers_json), baseline_months_to_goal = VALUES(baseline_months_to_goal), projected_months_to_goal = VALUES(projected_months_to_goal), final_net_worth = VALUES(final_net_worth)
